name: Vistabella de Huerva (Spain)
description: Red field with yellow stripes near the upper and lower edges, charged at the centre with a green tree bearing a small shield of the bars of Aragon.
history: Municipal flag of Vistabella de Huerva; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: tree bearing a small shield of the bars of Aragon
